summary: Verified new international-friendly date format on client Home /(client)/home.tsx NEXT 7 DAYS. Row 1 shows 'Today' with secondary 'Sun 12 Jul'; Row 2 shows 'Tomorrow' with secondary 'Mon 13 Jul'; Rows 3-7 show only 'EEE d MMM' (Tue 14 Jul, Wed 15 Jul, Thu 16 Jul, Fri 17 Jul, Sat 18 Jul). No ISO (YYYY-MM-DD) or slash (DD/MM/YYYY) dates appear inside the NEXT 7 DAYS section. Sorting is forward-going with TODAY on top. Calendar screen /(client)/calendar.tsx renders normally with 0 console errors after the change.
critical_code_review_comments: dayLabel uses `new Date(dateStr + 'T00:00:00')` (no Z) so it is parsed in the client's local timezone -- correct for the 'respect client local date' requirement.
Year branch (`d.getFullYear() !== now.getFullYear()`) could not be exercised at runtime since all next-7 dates fall in 2026; code inspection confirms the branch is wired correctly.
